purpose: Controlled vocabulary of FUNCTIONAL capabilities a prompt provides. Used by the capability resolver and as ranking signal R3. Deliberately small: 28 terms, no near-duplicates, no term finer than routing can act on.

design_decisions.functional_only: Capabilities describe what a prompt makes the output DO, not what artifact it is. Artifact type is already carried by `category` (10 values) and `subcategory` (200 values) and is already a ranking facet — restating it here would duplicate data and inflate the vocabulary without adding a signal.
design_decisions.no_umbrella_terms: No `a11y.wcag` alongside `a11y.keyboard`/`a11y.screen_reader`/`a11y.contrast`: an umbrella that is implied by its own members is a near-duplicate and makes overlap analysis meaningless. The specific mechanisms are kept, the umbrella is not.
design_decisions.merged_where_indistinguishable: sort merged into `data.filter_sort` (co-stated in ~all sources, 6.6% alone). CSV/PDF/JSON merged into `data.export`. WebSocket merged into `data.realtime`. Checkout and payment merged into `commerce.checkout` (they co-occur and no source distinguishes them usefully).

excluded_as_too_rare.commerce.subscription: 1.1% of records — below the level at which a routing signal is useful, and it is nearly always accompanied by commerce.checkout.
excluded_as_too_rare.i18n.generic: 2.6% — `layout.rtl` covers the concrete, checkable part of localization. Generic i18n claims are too vague to verify.

kept_despite_low_coverage.media.upload: 1.7% — retained because rarity makes it MORE discriminative for retrieval, not less. A query for a file-upload component should have a capability signal to match on.

confidence_levels.high: Matched an explicit acceptance_criterion, or implied by a subcategory whose artifact IS the capability. Acceptance criteria are explicit promises about the output, so they are the strongest available evidence.
confidence_levels.medium: Matched only in prompt text, negative_prompt or tags. Descriptive rather than promised.
confidence_levels.uncertain: Pattern matched but the evidence is ambiguous or the term is known to produce false positives. Emitted into a SEPARATE list and never treated as an assigned capability.

capabilities.label: Keyboard operability
capabilities.definition: Output is fully operable by keyboard: tab order, visible focus indication, focus trapping in overlays, escape-to-close.
capabilities.not: Does not cover screen-reader semantics — that is a11y.screen_reader.

capabilities.label: Screen-reader support
capabilities.definition: ARIA roles, labels, live regions or semantic markup so assistive technology can announce the interface.
capabilities.not: Does not cover keyboard operation or colour contrast.

capabilities.label: Colour contrast
capabilities.definition: Colour contrast explicitly meeting a stated threshold (typically WCAG AA).
capabilities.not: Generic mentions of 'accessible colours' without a threshold are uncertain, not this.

capabilities.label: Reduced-motion fallback
capabilities.definition: Honours prefers-reduced-motion by disabling or reducing non-essential animation.

capabilities.label: Responsive layout
capabilities.definition: Adapts across mobile, tablet and desktop breakpoints.

capabilities.label: Dark/light theming
capabilities.definition: Provides both dark and light colour schemes, typically with a toggle or system-preference detection.

capabilities.label: Right-to-left support
capabilities.definition: Supports RTL text direction with mirrored layout adaptation.

capabilities.label: Animation and transitions
capabilities.definition: Non-trivial motion: entrance/exit transitions, scroll-driven effects, physics or orchestrated timelines.
capabilities.not: A single CSS hover colour change is not this. See the rules file for the threshold applied.

capabilities.label: Form input
capabilities.definition: Collects structured user input through form controls.

capabilities.label: Input validation
capabilities.definition: Validates input and surfaces inline errors or success feedback.

capabilities.label: Search
capabilities.definition: Free-text search over content or datasets, including result highlighting or debounced input.

capabilities.label: Filtering and sorting
capabilities.definition: Narrows or reorders a result set by facets, ranges or column sort.

capabilities.label: Pagination and virtualization
capabilities.definition: Splits or windows large result sets: paging, infinite scroll, or virtual scrolling.

capabilities.label: Tabular data
capabilities.definition: Presents data in rows and columns as the primary display.

capabilities.label: Charts and visualization
capabilities.definition: Graphical data representation: charts, graphs, maps, diagrams, gauges.

capabilities.label: Export and download
capabilities.definition: Exports data or artifacts to a file — CSV, PDF, JSON, image.

capabilities.label: Live/real-time data
capabilities.definition: Updates without a user-initiated reload: websockets, polling, streaming, live metrics.

capabilities.label: Loading states
capabilities.definition: Explicit loading affordances: skeletons, shimmer, spinners tied to async work.

capabilities.label: Empty states
capabilities.definition: Explicit zero-data state with guidance on what to do next.

capabilities.label: Error handling
capabilities.definition: User-facing error states with recovery or retry, not just a thrown exception.

capabilities.label: Notifications
capabilities.definition: Transient or queued user feedback: toasts, snackbars, alert banners.

capabilities.label: Modal overlays
capabilities.definition: Modals, dialogs, drawers or sheets layered over the main content.

capabilities.label: Onboarding / multi-step flow
capabilities.definition: Guided first-run experience or a multi-step wizard with progress.

capabilities.label: Drag and drop
capabilities.definition: Direct manipulation by dragging: reordering, moving between containers, canvas placement.

capabilities.label: File upload
capabilities.definition: Accepts user files, typically with progress and type/size handling.

capabilities.label: Authentication
capabilities.definition: Login, signup, sessions, password handling or account state.

capabilities.label: Shopping cart
capabilities.definition: Cart state: add, remove, quantity, running total.

capabilities.label: Checkout and payment
capabilities.definition: Checkout flow and payment capture, including order confirmation.
